lines.zh: 我被丝吊着，只能原地打转。
lines.en: Hung by a thread, I can only spin in place.

lines.zh: 深色的壳在叶下像个影子。
lines.en: This dark shell hangs like a shadow under the leaf.

lines.zh: 风吹过来，我摆成一道弧。
lines.en: The wind comes and I swing in an arc.
I cannot shift an inch.
The branch shivers and I swing with it.

lines.zh: 我挂在叶子靠里的地方。
lines.en: I hang well in under the leaf.
My shell is nearly invisible.

lines.zh: 我在叶影里，比叶子更暗。
lines.en: In the leaf's shadow I am darker than the leaf.

lines.zh: 一片叶子托着我晃了一下午。
lines.en: One leaf has rocked me all afternoon.

lines.zh: 我慢慢被风带着转过去。
lines.en: The wind carries me slowly around.
I hang close along the vein.
I swing to the leaf tip and back.
Rain came and I swung harder.
That branch below is thicker than mine.
Where I hang, it is a fair way down.
I sway quietly and the wind sways too.

lines.zh: 我在壳里，听外面的响动。
lines.en: Inside my shell I listen to the outside.
The dark shell keeps the light out.
My wings are already folded inside.

lines.zh: 每天同一个位置，同一个角度。
lines.en: Same place each day, same angle.
I can feel the days turning colder.
There is a fine seam on the shell.

lines.zh: 树皮的味道比我记得的重。
lines.en: The smell of bark is stronger than I remembered.
An ant walked along my thread.

lines.zh: 我在等一个合适的日子。
lines.en: I am waiting for the right day.
It has grown crowded in here.
The underside of the leaf is cooler.

lines.zh: 我什么都不用做，只要等。
lines.en: I need do nothing but wait.
You nearly missed me.

lines.zh: 我在叶子底下，颜色又暗。
lines.en: I am under the leaf and dark.

lines.zh: 你凑这么近，我看清你的眼了。
lines.en: So close, and I see your eyes.
Do not take me for rotting bark.

lines.zh: 你伸手的时候，我在壳里往后退。
lines.en: When you reached, I shrank inside.

lines.zh: 这个壳挡不了你，我知道。
lines.en: This shell cannot stop you. I know.
Good eyes to find me.
Two more hang nearby.

lines.zh: 我现在只能挂着，别的都做不了。
lines.en: I can only hang here. Nothing else.

lines.zh: 你再等几天，我就不一样了。
lines.en: Give me a few days and I will be different.
A white scratch on the chrysalis.

lines.zh: 我被撞得转了好几个圈。
lines.en: I was knocked spinning.

lines.zh: 黑壳裂了，里面透出点光。
lines.en: The dark shell split and a little light shows through.
Hanging on the thread, the swinging sickens me.
A thin crack in my chrysalis.
I am still hanging here.

lines.zh: 黑壳上多了一道浅白的划痕。
lines.en: A pale scratch marks my black shell.
I am steadying.
The thread is strong. Not yet broken.
This much the shell can bear.
No mouth in this shell. Nothing to eat with.
The smell of the leaf seeps in.
I can smell it. I cannot taste it.

lines.zh: 你再晃叶子，我就转过来了。
lines.en: Shake that leaf again and I turn toward it.

lines.zh: 这些食物都不是给我的。
lines.en: None of that food is for me.
Once I am out I will find my own.

lines.zh: 甜的东西我怎么现在才闻到。
lines.en: Sweetness now, of all times.
I smelled it through the shell all night.
You cannot feed a shell.
Hung on a leaf, I can't move.

lines.zh: 你碰叶子，我就撞了树枝。
lines.en: You touched the leaf and I struck the branch.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的壳磕出个白印。
lines.en: That left a pale mark on my shell.
I swung violently and did not fall.

lines.zh: 你一脚踩断的枝离我很近。
lines.en: The twig you broke was close to mine.
I hang beyond your reach.
Do not knock this branch with anything.
I spun three or four times before stopping.
The bark grazes my shell.

lines.zh: 我晃回来的时候，撞了一下。
lines.en: On the swing back I hit something.

lines.zh: 你这下撞得整棵树都在动。
lines.en: That shook the whole tree.

lines.zh: 树上还有两个淡色的壳。
lines.en: There are two pale shells on this tree.
They are much brighter than me.
We hang on different branches.
I see them. I cannot go.
Something dark is coiled in theirs.
There is a dark shape in mine as well.
We all face the same way.
The day we open, we open together.
After we fly, none of us know each other.
While we hang, we count as company.

lines.zh: 叶子落了一片，擦过我的壳。
lines.en: A falling leaf brushed my shell.
Hanging here, I catch nothing.
Something has caught on my thread.
I shook and it did not come off.
A fruit rolled past below.
All of it is out of reach.
All I have is this shell.
That insect is still on my thread.
I have left that little thing where it is.
I can collect nothing.
Someone is crouched at the roots.
He is looking for something dark.

lines.zh: 他的目光扫过我的位置。
lines.en: His gaze swept across where I hang.
He did not pick me out.
He looked a second time.
This time he stopped.
He raised his hand slowly.
My shell is trembling.
His hand is half a foot away.
He let his hand drop.
He walked around to the other side of the tree.
He is comparing this shell.
He pushed the leaves aside.

lines.zh: 我这一下完全露出来了。
lines.en: I am fully exposed now.
He will not stop staring at me.
I have no legs to run with.
He leaned in very close.
He sniffed and frowned.
He shifted half a step back.
This time he actually left.
I knocked once inside the shell.
The seam opened a little.
I push until the shell rings.
He touched me, so I move.

lines.zh: 我的力量全在这层壳里。
lines.en: All my strength is inside this shell.
One more push and the seam widens.
I stop. I need to rest.
A small piece pushes out of the dark shell.
Even that counts as an answer.
I have no other means.
I hang in the shadow beneath a leaf.
This shell is nearly all black.

lines.zh: 丝从叶脉垂下来吊着我。
lines.en: A thread from the vein holds me up.
Those outside cannot see me.
The tree's shadow and I become one.
Inside, the wings are rolled tight.
I cannot move, and do not care to.
The bark of this tree is dark.
I have a great deal of patience.

lines.zh: 等壳开的那天，我会是蓝黑的。
lines.en: When the shell opens I will be blue-black.
The dark shell went soft in the heat.

lines.zh: 丝断了，我直接掉在地里。
lines.en: The thread snapped and I fell to the earth.

lines.zh: 雨积在叶弯里，把我泡住了。
lines.en: Rain pooled in the leaf's curve and soaked me.
The blast tore a gash in the leaf.

lines.zh: 一枚东西嵌进了我的壳。
lines.en: Something is embedded in my shell.
That strange light shone right through the shell.
What is inside the shell is all that feeds me.
The lightning was close enough to smell.

lines.zh: 叶子和树都没了，我在掉。
lines.en: Leaf and tree are gone. I am falling.
